searchText: how do you feel about PoS rewards 🤔 or the eth/beth divide tax issues are an unavoidable consequence of core dev work <@!532654603238375425> If I were you, and I still believed this was a real issue that needed to be addressed, I would go all the way back to the beginning. and try to come at this fresh, listening to the the things that make the token proposal difficult and looking for whether there's a solution that doesn't introduce lots of new problems. Listening to what Tim just said would be very valuable because your proposal has lots of assumptions about who wants to vote or that we even want to vote... Not true, you can be a core dev and not hold or touch crypto in any way that is meaningful with respect to tax liability. I don't have opinions about the other two things. You are still making decisions regarding other people's taxes This feel pedantic you brought up taxes not me o.O > And saying that tax issues are a non-issue is naive. My point was that any core dev can claim it (pull model) so any core dev can decide whther she wishes to participate. > I would not want to vote. You can therefore vote based on your best judgment- internalize the opinions of those who you believe can make the best choice, and choose I want to answer in long form <@!364458974906548225> - what do you say I'll update the ethresearch post in Q&A form, and we'll resume the discussion afterwards? You may do whatever you please, but I'm going to opt out of this discussion. You seem attached to the solution and not very interested in viewing it through a critical eye. Not a good combination for having a productive discussion. Oh, I’m very open to changing it, but there were a lot of comments and I don’t want to just try and defend my idea - I want to take the time and internalize your points
